provenance: Five original user questions supplied verbatim in the follow-up handoff, plus ten authored compound workflow questions and two authored negatives. Not a historic manual transcript. Frozen before the first live run.

purpose: guessing from stale or generic documentation
product: DocAtlas is a local-first documentation and context runtime for coding agents
It turns reviewable project docs, lockfiles, and approved dependency documentation into compact, source-attributed evidence for coding agents
reading: New contributors should start by reading `README.md`, this `CONTRIBUTING.md`
application: `docmancer/docs/application/` | Project, library and unified context workflows
domain: `docmancer/docs/domain/` | Ranking, trust, source identity and policy rules
mcp_boundary: `docmancer/mcp/docs_server.py` | Public documentation tools, resources and transport boundary
infrastructure_boundary:
SQLite owns persistence and
candidate generation; metadata-only matching may discover a candidate but
cannot qualify public evidence
flow_mcp:
The MCP boundary is `get_docs_context(question, project_path, lookup_queries?,
module_path?, scope?)`
flow_application: `ProjectContextService` builds one query plan and passes it to project retrieval
flow_gateway:
The retrieval gateway provides filtered project chunks, field-level lexical
match provenance, and exact-source indexed sections
flow_selection:
For compound reads, selection maximizes distinct user-visible query coverage
before expanding snippets
Compound projection selects compact witnesses for distinct lookup IDs before expanding snippets with remaining capacity, then requalifies coverage against the visible path, section, and snippet
selection_domain:
Domain policies own lineage, source-role
eligibility, and visible evidence qualification
selection_application:
Candidate allocation gives one opportunity to exact-anchor, original-question,
and host-query lanes before consuming second candidates
selection_proof: It may only mark a mandatory facet covered when a model-visible answer unit locally proves that exact obligation
Evidence selection chooses candidates by requiring locally bound subject, relation, and value proof for every mandatory facet; complete exact proof outranks compact generic text
isolation: Each project identity receives isolated SQLite index
authoritative: Reviewable repository files remain the source of
parents: semantic parent sections based on heading structure
selection: bounded candidates into an auditable certification decision
not_proof: a retrieval hit is not proof
offline_test: DOCATLAS_OFFLINE=1 pytest tests/ -m "not advanced and not live and not live_network"
tool_context: `get_docs_context` | First documentation question about a repository, dependency, library, or a mix
`get_docs_context` | Default first call for project, library, dependency, or mixed documentation questions
tool_prepare: `prepare_docs` | The exact lifecycle action returned by `get_docs_context`, or an explicit user-approved sync/refresh request
`prepare_docs` | Lifecycle work only: sync, refresh, index, or prefetch
tool_status: `docs_status` | A returned job id, index health, freshness, or status request
`docs_status` | Explicit health, freshness, index, or background-job status requests only
health: Explicit health, freshness, index, or background-job status requests only
reserved for explicit health, freshness, index, and job
